recommendation: Keep the source fix as-is. It removes the only discovered authoritative QuestionnaireResponse source text that could lead implementers to the obsolete context element while preserving the already-correct structural application of FHIR-19510. Handle any broader workflow-family issues only in separate bounded reconciliations.
issue_request: FHIR-19510 was Published/Persuasive for the FHIR-I QuestionnaireAnswers/QuestionnaireResponse artifact. It asked that the former context element be renamed to Encounter/encounter, constrained to 0..1 Reference(Encounter), and described as the Encounter during which the record was created or to which creation is tightly associated; EpisodeOfCare linkage was to be handled by extension.
initial_application: Commit 9b1695bfd4, later merged by ecdd7d61, changed QuestionnaireResponse.context to QuestionnaireResponse.encounter in the spreadsheet and example and changed the type from Reference(Encounter|EpisodeOfCare) to Reference(Encounter). The current StructureDefinition already has QuestionnaireResponse.encounter with min 0, max 1, targetProfile Encounter, and the requested definition.
additional_context: QuestionnaireResponse is an active resource in source/fhir.ini. The remaining QuestionnaireResponse.context reference in source/fhir.ini is in the r2-renames migration section, not current element guidance. Later pattern-alignment commit bd2e3c688f added a QuestionnaireResponse.partOf comment that reintroduced stale wording telling readers to use context for Encounter linkage. Related workflow-family issues such as FHIR-17901, FHIR-19511, and FHIR-19516 confirm the broader context-to-encounter migration but are separate or already represented elsewhere on the combined branch.
reconciliation: Updated source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml so the QuestionnaireResponse.partOf comment says to use encounter for Encounter linkage, and fixed the adjacent article in the same sentence. No structural change was needed because QuestionnaireResponse.encounter already satisfies the requested 0..1 Reference(Encounter) rule.
source_changes: source/questionnaireresponse/structuredefinition-QuestionnaireResponse.xml: changed the QuestionnaireResponse.partOf comment from use 'context' for Encounter linkage to use 'encounter'.
